enabled.markdownDescription:
Collect usage history

When outputs switch, covers move and buttons are pressed, by hour of
the day - no more. An API key in the Propose or Write scope can read
the summary, and what an AI reads goes to its vendor: it shows when
somebody is at home.
enabled.title: Enabled

days.markdownDescription:
Days kept

Older days are dropped. The file is written once an hour.
days.title: Days

usage_history.description: Hourly counts of how outputs, covers and inputs are used, kept on the controller, for an AI assistant to suggest automations from. Off unless turned on; turning it off deletes what was collected.
usage_history.title: Usage history
